goal: Prevent peer message processing from blocking on cs_main when a peer has no orphan work queued
Avoid unnecessary latency in handling P2P messages while validation, RPC, or wallet threads hold the lock
reviewability: Small two-line change with an accompanying unit test
agreement: Suggested only pursuing this if refactoring in #36244 is an accepted goal (instagibbs)
Author replied that avoiding cs_main contention has standalone value on master today

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it eliminates unconditional cs_main lock contention during routine peer message processing
Prevents validation and RPC activity from stalling message loops when no orphan work is pending
Microbenchmarks show ping handling latency dropping from 50 ms to 0.02 ms under lock contention
